 [RIDES] Actor Jim Caviezel Shows Off His Rare Corvette ZR1X
 By Keith Cornett - Nov 10, 2026 2 1538 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp 
Actor Jim Caviezel may be best known for portraying Jesus Christ in “The Passion of the Christ,” but get him talking about his new Corvette ZR1X and he sounds like any other proud Corvette owner. In a short video from Jetset Magazine , Caviezel gives us a walkaround of his Corvette and shares a few of the personal touches he’s added.
 Among those changes are yellow accents in the engine compartment, replacing pieces he says originally came in red. Those now tie in with the yellow brake calipers and custom yellow ZR1X badges, and he says the car has also been wrapped to create the matte look. Then there’s his personal “JC33” emblem with a lightning bolt, a design he says appears on his other vehicles and motorcycles as well.
Caviezel explains that the emblem references both his initials and Jesus Christ, along with being 33 years old when he was struck by lightning while filming “The Passion of the Christ.” That’s certainly a more personal backstory than your typical Corvette badge!
 His connection to Corvette goes back quite a bit further than this latest purchase. Caviezel drove the 2003 50th Anniversary Corvette pace car at the 2002 Indianapolis 500, and he marvels at how far Chevrolet has taken the car since then. Now he’s enjoying a twin-turbo V8 and electric all-wheel drive, with plenty of enthusiasm for taking on the European exotics.
He also appreciates the ownership side of the equation, praising the Corvette’s ease of maintenance and value. Caviezel says he’s grateful GM gave him the opportunity to get a ZR1X, acknowledging that they’re hard to get.
 Check out the video below. Whether he’s talking about the performance or showing off those matching yellow accents, we can tell he’s having fun with this one.
